issue.title: Next UI: Waveform, Verse chip, Page dots and Level wave
issue.body:
Next UI components for the Listen player and the Recorder, built with the `figma-component` workflow. They're presentational and run on sample data in the gallery for now.

Figma: [Wave bar](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2409-505) · [Verse chip](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2409-502) · [Page dot](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2409-508) · [Level wave](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2595-772)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Waveform` draws each verse as a Verse chip (Current once reached, Default ahead) and its Wave bars (Played `fg/primary`, Unplayed `fg/inactive`), driven by a 0–1 progress, and scrolls under a playhead held about a third across
- [ ] `Waveform` only mounts bars near the screen, so long passages stay light
- [ ] `PageDots`: the current page is 14pt `fg/primary`, the rest 10pt `fg/inactive`, `space/8` apart
- [ ] `LevelWave` short: the last 16 input levels, resting as dots and lifting into bars
- [ ] `LevelWave` long: recorded levels as bars, resting ticks ahead, and a playhead at the recording front that holds two thirds across
- [ ] Progress and position are announced to TalkBack; bars, chips and ticks are hidden from it
- [ ] Gallery demos do the real jobs: the Listen player waveform with page dots and Play · Previous · Next, and recording a take that drives both Level wave sizes (levels are simulated)
- [ ] Unit tests for each component
- [ ] The `figma-component` skill holds PRs until the user asks for one

Needs QA? Yes (motion and feel need a real device)

Follow-ups: live mic levels for the long Level wave and the unplayed bar contrast are tracked in `docs/features/next-ui-redesign/open-questions.md` (Q6, Q20).
